name: campaign-kit
description: Generates complete campaigns (image + video) from logo, references and briefing — and, with /campaign-kit:copy, copy only (PPC + overlay) from briefing + examples. Runs locally, with a technical-direction field, asset approval and piece review in the browser (regenerations show a processing indicator and the new image replaces the old one in place), and a Visual | Copy switch between the two wizards.
